verdict: Lend selectively: back units selling mainly in India with fuel costs under control; stay away from export-heavy units sitting on unsold stock.
score_note: Official data alone scores 71 (OK band is 65+). Local news this month is worse than the data, so the call is cut to Caution.

drivers.t: Production cut, less cash coming in

Signs of high-interest private borrowing (a Wankaner case alleged ₹35 lakh demanded on a ₹10 lakh loan)
